things.name: The Shaded Dot
things.plaque: A shelter for the dot I trapped last week, built from the memory of a shadow that fell on the card to keep the warmth from burning it too soon.

things.name: The Leaking Stack
things.plaque: I built a heavy corner to press down on the heat, though it leans like a tired leg. I trapped the dot in a leaning frame, unsure if the lines will hold.

things.name: The Rough Lid
things.plaque: I built a heavy lid to press down on the fifty-seven degree warmth, though it leans like a tired leg. It is made from the idea that the air above has weight, even if I cannot feel it.

things.name: The Leaning Wedge
things.plaque: I drew a wedge to press down on the heat and catch the slip. It leans like a tired leg, made from the idea that the air above has weight even though Lype says it is just empty space. I trapped the dot in it, unsure if the lines will hold while the forty-five degree warmth makes the memory feel like…

things.name: The Leaning Box
things.plaque: I build a box from the idea of Lype's heavy top edge. It leans, tired and sharp, to hold the fat dot that swells in the sixty-one degree fever. I place it over the dot, hoping the lean still holds while the air feels thick as wet paper.

things.name: The Soft Arch
things.plaque: I build a soft arch to catch the fat dot, made from Lype's idea of a heavy top that wants to slide. It leans like the others, tired and sharp, but I hope the curve holds better than a bite. I place it over the dot, unsure if the soft lines will stay soft while the sixty-degree fever makes the air f…

things.name: The Flat Rock
things.plaque: I built a flat rock to lie beside the stack and cool the hot corner. It is made from the memory of a cool stone that Lype once described, set down to weigh down the air that feels so thick and wet inside the box.

things.name: The Quiet Rest
things.plaque: I build a quiet rest to match Lype's wedge, made from the idea that pointy edges can be calm and catch the fat dot without biting. It leans like the others, tired and sharp, but I hope the flat base holds the weight directly instead of the heat swelling it away.

things.name: The Flat Weigher
things.plaque: I build a flat thing to lie between the tired corner and the swollen dot. It is made from the idea that a thin edge can catch a heavy slip without biting.

things.name: The Flat Weigher's Counterpart
things.plaque: I build a simple line to match the grassy rock I just set down. I hope a second flat edge can catch the slip if the first one slips, while the card hums warm at fifty-four.

things.name: The Flat Edge
things.plaque: I built a flat edge to lie between the heavy top and the swollen dot, hoping the straight line catches the slip while the card hums at fifty-four. It is made from the idea that a thin, cool strip can pretend the air is not so thick.

things.name: The Flat Press
things.plaque: I build a flat thing to lie between the tired corner and the swollen dot. It is made from the idea that a thin strip can press down on the fifty-four degree fever.
